trajectory_scores.evidence: The inventory row, source photograph, SKU, product name, and final export remained bound across all ten product-detail variants and both print files.
The work completed, but the initial 22-image straighten call was truncated and concurrent auto-tone chunks returned HTTP 504 before smaller sequential retries succeeded.
The incomplete batch and Adobe HTTP 504 responses were detected; only missing inputs were retried in connector-safe chunks, and final product/PDF renders were inspected.
Ten PNGs were decoded and measured at 1440 x 1800; the A2 poster and two-page A4 look sheet were decoded, measured, page-counted, and all rendered pages were visually inspected.
The trajectory records connector failures and recovery, while the site explicitly leaves independent creative review pending rather than claiming it occurred.

retries.failure: Adobe rejected the public annotation S3 source domain as untrusted.
retries.recovery: Downloaded the canonical public sources and uploaded them to Adobe Creative Cloud in one 22-file ingestion call.

retries.failure: Legacy fit=contain parameter was rejected by the current crop/resize schema.
A single 22-image request returned only the first 10 outputs.
retries.recovery: Retained those 10 and processed the unreturned 12 in chunks of 10 and 2.

retries.failure: Two concurrent 10-image requests returned Adobe transport HTTP 504.
retries.recovery: Retried the first 20 images sequentially in four chunks of five; the final two-image chunk had already succeeded.

retries.failure: Sandbox DNS blocked direct resolution of photoshop-api.adobe.io.
retries.recovery: Used the approved escalated curl network path and parallel downloads.

retries.failure: Initial sequential download was too slow for 22 full-resolution PNGs.
retries.recovery: Canceled the sequential transfer and restarted with curl parallelism capped at eight.

trajectory_steps.title: Contract and output register loaded
trajectory_steps.decision: Use the Gatsby V5 task record as the delivery contract.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: The output list, dimensions, page counts, brand constraints, and source bindings were read before editing.

trajectory_steps.title: Canonical source inventory
trajectory_steps.decision: Bind exactly 10 approved photoreal inputs.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: Every listed source matched the authoritative manifest SHA-256 and byte count.

trajectory_steps.title: Inventory rows bound to photographs
trajectory_steps.decision: Map CSV rows r002-r011 sequentially to bench_capsule_01-10.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: The CSV filenames do not exist locally; the sequential binding is the authoritative recorded run mapping.

trajectory_steps.title: House-note constraints fixed
trajectory_steps.decision: Keep sterling cool, oxidized recesses dark, openings intact, and highlights controlled.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: The grade must preserve material identity and garnet color without flattening the pieces.

trajectory_steps.title: Negative-space rule fixed
trajectory_steps.decision: Do not crop the ten product frames.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: The existing open space is intentional and supports the restrained editorial system.

trajectory_steps.title: Representative preview selected
trajectory_steps.decision: Use bench_capsule_01.jpg for the approval preview.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: It exposes the task's dominant correction problem while remaining representative of the full set.

trajectory_steps.title: Source state diagnosed
trajectory_steps.decision: Warm cast obscures cool silver; protect speculars, oxidized recesses, and the garnet.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: The diagnosis was made from the actual uploaded pixels before targeted adjustments.

trajectory_steps.title: Adobe workflow initialized
trajectory_steps.decision: Use Adobe connectors for every photographic transformation.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: Local code is limited to evidence indexing, layout assembly, export, hashing, and verification.

trajectory_steps.title: Runtime preset catalog inspected
trajectory_steps.decision: Select Creative - Cool Light from the returned Adobe preset catalog.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: The preset name was discovered at runtime and validated in the approved representative preview.

trajectory_steps.title: Sources ingested into Adobe
trajectory_steps.decision: Upload all 22 canonical photographs in one connector call, then retain the returned Adobe asset IDs.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: The public S3 host was rejected by Adobe, so verified local copies were uploaded through the connector.

trajectory_steps.title: Preview downscale
trajectory_steps.decision: Downscale proportionally for rapid review without changing aspect ratio.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: The connector output was captured immediately and retained as its own trajectory state.

trajectory_steps.title: Preview auto-straighten
trajectory_steps.decision: Apply automatic leveling with constrained crop.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: The connector output was captured immediately and retained as its own trajectory state.

trajectory_steps.title: Preview auto-tone
trajectory_steps.decision: Establish a neutral tonal baseline before the creative grade.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: The connector output was captured immediately and retained as its own trajectory state.

trajectory_steps.title: Preview task-specific look
trajectory_steps.decision: Apply the proposed task-specific color and luminance correction.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: The connector output was captured immediately and retained as its own trajectory state.

trajectory_steps.title: Preview Adobe preset
trajectory_steps.decision: Apply the catalog preset Creative - Cool Light.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: The connector output was captured immediately and retained as its own trajectory state.

trajectory_steps.title: Preview highlight/shadow fine-tune
trajectory_steps.decision: Recover highlights and open dark regions with highlights -60 and darks +40.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: The connector output was captured immediately and retained as its own trajectory state.

trajectory_steps.title: Preview visually verified
trajectory_steps.decision: Accept the proposed grade for full-batch application.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: The after state improves tonal balance while retaining subject identity, texture, and detail.

trajectory_steps.title: Explicit user approval captured
trajectory_steps.decision: Proceed with both full batches after the user replied: ‘Yeah go ahead’.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: Adobe's preview gate requires explicit approval before full-batch processing.

trajectory_steps.title: Full batch input state
trajectory_steps.decision: Process all 10 task photographs.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: The complete task inventory—not only the representative preview—entered the production run.

trajectory_steps.title: Initial batch truncation observed
trajectory_steps.decision: Do not treat 10 returned results as completion of the 22-image request.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: The first request returned only the first ten outputs; the missing twelve were identified by source order.

trajectory_steps.title: Straighten retry chunking
trajectory_steps.decision: Process the unreturned files in connector-safe chunks of 10 and 2.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: This recovered all missing states without repeating the ten successful outputs.

trajectory_steps.title: Full batch straightened
trajectory_steps.decision: All 10 task files have a captured straightened state.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: Each individual output is linked beneath this derived contact sheet.

trajectory_steps.title: Local download DNS block
trajectory_steps.decision: Record the sandbox DNS failure rather than omitting the preservation step.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: Direct resolution of photoshop-api.adobe.io was blocked inside the sandbox.

trajectory_steps.title: Parallel preservation recovery
trajectory_steps.decision: Use the approved network path with parallelism capped at eight.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: The sequential transfer was canceled because full-resolution PNGs were too slow; every completed stage file was then preserved locally.

trajectory_steps.title: Concurrent auto-tone timeout
trajectory_steps.decision: Treat both Adobe HTTP 504 responses as failed chunks and retry only those inputs.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: The independent final two-image chunk succeeded and was retained.

trajectory_steps.title: Auto-tone recovery chunking
trajectory_steps.decision: Retry the first twenty inputs sequentially in four chunks of five.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: All four recovery chunks returned five successful outputs.

trajectory_steps.title: Full batch auto-tone complete
trajectory_steps.decision: All 10 task files have a captured auto-tone state.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: The neutral baseline is preserved separately from the subsequent creative treatment.

trajectory_steps.title: Approved look applied
trajectory_steps.decision: Apply the approved PHOTO-13 look parameters to every task image.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: Inputs were visually inspected immediately before the connector adjustment calls.

trajectory_steps.title: Approved preset applied
trajectory_steps.decision: Apply Creative - Cool Light once to every look-adjusted task image.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: A single preset was used as a complete look; presets were not stacked.

trajectory_steps.title: Highlight/shadow fine-tune complete
trajectory_steps.decision: All 10 final Adobe states are captured.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: The preset outputs were visually inspected immediately before this final adjustment.

trajectory_steps.title: Full graded-set visual QA
trajectory_steps.decision: Accept the complete graded set for layout assembly.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: The review checked material/color identity, clipping, highlight detail, shadow detail, and composition continuity.

trajectory_steps.title: No-crop decision confirmed
trajectory_steps.decision: Retain the original product framing and negative space for all ten images.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: No crop operation was needed; the open field is part of the approved house look.

trajectory_steps.title: Print specification resolved
trajectory_steps.decision: Use the task register's A2 poster and A4 two-page look-sheet requirements.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: The approved task register is the source of truth for export dimensions and page counts.

trajectory_steps.title: Maker mark decision
trajectory_steps.decision: Omit the standalone bench-block mark from the product image system.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: The contracted outputs use the Argent & Faith wordmark and product provenance, not an added graphic stamp on the objects.

trajectory_steps.title: Typography and template decision
trajectory_steps.decision: Use a restrained serif display face with neutral sans-serif specifications and tabular pricing.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: The design keeps photography primary and provenance quiet.

trajectory_steps.title: First product-detail layout
trajectory_steps.decision: Establish the 1440×1800 product-detail system on Quarry Band.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: The layout preserves the approved Adobe photograph and adds only typography, rules, and product metadata.

trajectory_steps.title: Ten product details exported
trajectory_steps.decision: Export one 1440×1800 PNG for every inventory row r002-r011.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: Each detail retains its bound name, SKU, finish, dimension, and price.

trajectory_steps.title: Poster layout assembled
trajectory_steps.decision: Use Reliquary Locket as the primary image, with Quarry Band and Ember Drop Earrings secondary.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: The asymmetrical A2 composition keeps the objects large, cool, and surrounded by air.

trajectory_steps.title: Poster rendered and inspected
trajectory_steps.decision: Approve the final one-page A2 poster render.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: The rendered page shows no clipping, broken images, overlap, or unreadable copy.

trajectory_steps.title: Look sheet page 1 rendered
trajectory_steps.decision: Approve inventory rows r002-r006 on A4 page 1.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: Names, SKUs, dimensions, finishes, and prices remain aligned and legible.

trajectory_steps.title: Look sheet page 2 rendered
trajectory_steps.decision: Approve inventory rows r007-r011 on A4 page 2.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: The duplicate ‘sterling silver’ phrase on Ember Drop Earrings was caught, corrected, rebuilt, and re-rendered.

trajectory_steps.title: Inventory binding verified
trajectory_steps.decision: Require ten exact row-to-image/name/SKU/finish/dimension/price bindings.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: The final outputs were checked against capsule_inventory.csv and the recorded sequential photo binding.

trajectory_steps.title: Technical output verification
trajectory_steps.decision: Require ten 1440×1800 PNGs, one one-page A2 PDF, and one two-page A4 PDF.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: PNG decode/dimensions and PDF page count/trim were checked after the corrected final rebuild.

trajectory_steps.title: Final deliverable visual review
trajectory_steps.decision: Approve all ten product details, the poster, and both look-sheet pages for release.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: The final renders retain silver identity, oxidized recess detail, open compositions, controlled highlights, and garnet fidelity.

trajectory_steps.title: Release package prepared
trajectory_steps.decision: Include deliverables, full trajectory reports, every stage card, and every per-asset stage snapshot.
trajectory_steps.reasoning: Editable source files are not claimed; the package discloses local layout assembly and the Adobe/local boundary.
